preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.
The number of friends is less than the number of rooms, and both are less than or equal to 200,000.
Each friend is in a room numbered between 2 and n.
The rooms connected by each corridor are numbered between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: The sum of n over all test cases is not greater than 2 * 10^5
preconditions.description: The total number of rooms across all test cases is not greater than 200,000.

postconditions.expression: Output is -1 if Vlad wins anyway
postconditions.description: If Vlad can always win regardless of the friends' positions, the output should be -1.

postconditions.expression: Output is a minimal number of friends that must remain in the maze
postconditions.description: If friends can win, the output should be the smallest number of friends that can prevent Vlad from winning.

invariants.expression: The maze is a tree structure
invariants.description: The room system forms an undirected tree, meaning there is a unique path between any two rooms.
Each unit of time, all participants (Vlad and friends) can move through one corridor.

invariants.expression: All friends know the maze layout
invariants.description: Friends know the plan of the maze and intend to win, aiming to catch Vlad before he reaches a room with exactly one exit.
